description.0: A longsword that is entirely gemstone, said to be crafted for the path of righteousness. When unsheathed, it glows with the luster of blue flame.

0.0: Triggering an Elemental Reaction increases the equipping character's ATK by <cryo>16%</cryo> for 12s. Triggering a Stellar Glimmer reaction increases their Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG dealt by <cryo>16%</cryo> for 12s. The aforementioned effects can trigger even when the character is not on the field.
